elements.name: object 21
elements.text:
Level / role | Primary access | Approval responsibility
L1 - HOD / final approver | All QMS files; final review; edit/delete rights where configured. | Approve or reject after L2 review. Admin is treated as L1.
L2 - Assistant Manager / Manager | All QMS files and first-stage review workspace. | Review, select recipients and send to L1; or reject with comments.
L3 - Procedure viewer | SOPs, IATF audit plans, Records and IATF Standards. | No approval decision.
L4 - Checksheet viewer | Records only. | No approval decision.
High-level roles | Admin, Manager, Supervisor and Approver can access Archive and System Log. | Decision rights still follow QMS level.
Admin | Full system access including People directory. | Final approval capability and user oversight.
